newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil announces schedule for debt issue roadshows.
newsitem.headline: Brazil announces schedule for debt issue roadshows.

text.p: Brazilian government officials began on Monday eight days of roadshows for the country's upcoming $750 million, five-year global issue, the Central Bank said.

Two teams, led by Central Bank International Affairs director Gustavo Franco and National Treasury Sectretary Murilo Portugal, were due to present the issue to investors in the United States, Europe and Asia, it said in a statement.
The following was the scheduled dates for the roadshows of the two teams.
-- Oct 21, Los Angeles and San Francisco;
The Central Bank said the decision to divide the roadshows between two groups had been taken "because of the short time available" and the large number of financial centers to be visited.
